title: France's competition watchdog orders Meta to negotiate in good faith with news organizations over copyright payments, after two groups filed complaints in 2025 (Benoit Berthelot/Bloomberg)
summary: Benoit Berthelot / Bloomberg: France's competition watchdog orders Meta to negotiate in good faith with news organizations over copyright payments, after two groups filed complaints in 2025 — Meta Platforms Inc. was ordered by the French competition watchdog to hold talks with news organizations over copyright payments …
